t: Duckhams QS 5W-30 (5Ltr) engine oil is a fully synthetic lubricant designed for modern passenger cars. The high-performance engine oil is particularly suitable for mechanics servicing Ford vehicles, including DuraTec, DuraTorq, and Zetec engines. Formulated with advanced additive technology, it meets ACEA A5/B5 specifications for both petrol and diesel engines. The formulation ensures robust engine protection and promotes significant fuel economy benefits, helping to maintain engine efficiency and longevity.
b: Optimised for Ford DuraTec, DuraTorq & Zetec Engines
Robust Engine Protection & Extended Engine Life
Promotes Fuel Economy in Modern Petrol & Diesel Vehicles
